faq_heading: Port Coquitlam commercial real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. Sale and lease listings.

Commercial property for sale in Port Coquitlam: industrial buildings and strata units, offices, retail space, commercial land and businesses listed on the MLS®. The search shows space for sale and for lease. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 for a property that is not listed, or to value one you own.
Commercial and industrial areas in Port Coquitlam

items.t: Port Coquitlam has 445 hectares of industrial land (July 1, 2025); Mary Hill (396 hectares) is the largest industrial area in the Northeast Sector. ([Metro Vancouver 2025 Industrial Lands Inventory](https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-planning/Documents/mv-industrial-lands-inventory-summary-report-appendices-2025.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

Industrial zones in Port Coquitlam are M1 to M4, and building, plumbing and fire inspectors visit before an industrial business licence is issued. ([City of Port Coquitlam, business licencing](https://www.portcoquitlam.ca/business-development/doing-business/business-licencing), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: What sold across the Lower Mainland

Commercial Edge does not break out Port Coquitlam in the figures published on this site. Across the Lower Mainland, 285 commercial properties sold in the second quarter of 2026, worth $1,540.8M: 81 industrial, 56 land, 46 office, 82 retail and other, and 20 multi-family.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
